content.title: Request a published book detail page that does not exist and receive a 404
content.intent: Prove that a missing published-book detail request returns a 404 rather than rendering a misleading detail page.
content.technique_notes: Derived from REQ-08's explicit missing-resource behavior. Techniques: negative/error over resource state {nonexistent published book}. Kept separate because requesting a nonexistent book changes the outcome to an error page instead of a successful detail page. No covering array applied: the source specifies no independent input dimensions to combine; the risk-judged interaction strength would have been 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies.
